name: Ninja Smasher!
description:
An exhilarating 2D ninja action game where you control a ninja and fight against an army of monsters!
Ninja runs! Ninja flies! Ninja kills!
The nimble actions performed by the ninja are extremely exhilarating!

Use various ninja techniques such as swords, shuriken, and ninjutsu to rescue the kidnapped princess!
platform_name: ニンテンドー3DSダウンロードソフト
disclaimer: This software does not support 3D display.
